{{Quote|All right, if it's the sewers you want, there's only one place to go. But you'll never get in.|Haja Estree, to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Kenobi" />}}
'''The Den''' was a shady business in [[Daiyu City]] on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]], which contained a [[spice]] laboratory and a place for playing [[sabacc]]. A [[Color|purple]] sign on the building, written in [[Aurebesh]], stated the name of the business, while a red sign over a door read "sabacc," emblazoned with playing cards cards at the bottom. A similar, blue sign could be seen on the street. A sign on the roof of the building read "spice," as did a street sign.<ref name="Kenobi" />

==History==
[[File:TheDenSpiceLab-OWKpII.png|thumb|left|300px|The spice lab in The Den.]]
While searching for a kidnapped [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] asked [[Haja Estree]] for directions to "the sewers." Estree told him where to go but warned Kenobi that he believed he would never get in. Kenobi arrived at The Den, and noticed a worker wearing a lab coat, exiting a door with a sign saying "[[sabacc]]." Disguising himself as one of the workers, Kenobi snuck into the premises and entered a makeshift [[spice]] laboratory, where he caused a glass tank to explode, creating a distraction that allowed him to slip through a door. He was confronted by two guards, a [[Unidentified Zabrak spice den guard|Zabrak]] and [[Unidentified Human spice den guard|human]] worker, who queried about his presence. Kenobi fought the pair, who put up a fierce fight, but managed to subdue them and forced the [[Human]] guard to reveal where Leia was being held.<ref name="Kenobi" />

Kenobi found a cell with a hooded figure whom he believed to be Princess Leia. However, it turned out to be a derelict [[droid]] serving as a decoy, and Kenobi was captured by [[Vect Nokru]]'s [[Vidara Jurness|green-skinned alien]] and [[Unidentified Nikto mercenary (Vect Nokru)|Nikto]] associates, who restrained him. Nokru mocked Kenobi for risking everything for a "little brat" and believed that he and [[Black Mask|his associates]] would get rich from Kenobi's capture when they handed him over to the [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]]. Kenobi demanded to know Leia's whereabouts but Nokru dismissed him as a mere man who [[Blood|bleeds]]. Kenobi replied that "everybody bleeds," before dropping a vial of red spice that blinded the mercenaries. Kenobi took the opportunity to escape and locked the kidnappers in their own cell.<ref name="Kenobi" />

Kenobi then found Leia and lead her out of the sewers into the streets of [[Daiyu]], through the same door that he entered earlier. Meanwhile, Nokru and his associates struggled with the effects of the spice as the Third Sister showed up and angrily demanded to know Kenobi's whereabouts.<ref name="Kenobi" />
